name: frostling_wolf_rider
description: a Frostling Wolf Rider, a small blue-skinned frost goblin with wild spiky white hair, big pointed ears, a toothy grin, a cream fur mantle, round icy-blue shoulder and knee pads and brown leather straps, an ice-crystal-tipped spear with a brown wooden shaft in his LEFT hand, riding a huge snarling white wolf with a shaggy white-and-pale-blue coat, icy blue eyes, bared white fangs, a black nose, brown leather reins and a bushy white tail
hands: the ice-tipped spear stays in the goblin's left hand on the screen-right side, angled up toward the upper-right, and his right hand holds the wolf's reins on the screen-left side; the wolf has no weapon: it fights with its fangs

strike.4: contact: the goblin leans far forward over the white wolf's neck with his weapon arm fully extended, the ice-tipped spear thrust out along a line to the lower-right, its point the farthest point of the figure; the white wolf lunges far forward toward the lower-right, low, its neck stretched out, jaws open with fangs bared, hind legs driving; both face the lower-right

flinch.1: recoil extreme: the white wolf rears back onto its haunches toward the upper-left, head tossed up, snarling; the goblin leans back, still astride the wolf
